parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.incidents (
  incident_id, source_reference, order_id, customer_id, customer_name,
  subject, incident_type, description, priority, status, telegram_chat_id,
  created_at, updated_at
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'support_request', $7, $8, $9, $10, $11::timestamptz, now()
)
ON CONFLICT (incident_id) DO UPDATE SET
  source_reference = EXCLUDED.source_reference,
  order_id = EXCLUDED.order_id,
  customer_id = EXCLUDED.customer_id,
  customer_name = EXCLUDED.customer_name,
  subject = EXCLUDED.subject,
  description = EXCLUDED.description,
  priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
  telegram_chat_id = COALESCE(public.incidents.telegram_chat_id, EXCLUDED.telegram_chat_id),
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING incident_id, source_reference, telegram_message_id, telegram_chat_id;

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.incidents
  SET telegram_message_id = $2, telegram_notified_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE incident_id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING incident_id
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO public.integration_logs (event_id, event_type, order_id, workflow_name, execution_id, integration_status, created_at)
  VALUES ($3, 'support.requested', $4, 'SIE - Incidencia y Telegram', $5, 'completed', now())
  RETURNING integration_status
)
SELECT (SELECT incident_id FROM updated) AS incident_id, (SELECT integration_status FROM logged) AS integration_status;
